input_selector.label: Search input CSS selector
input_selector.info: The theme's search box. Default matches most themes (Dawn included).

ab_testing.label: Enable A/B experiments on the storefront
ab_testing.info: When on, an anonymous visitor token is used only after analytics consent is granted.

metafield_key.label: Metafield facet key
metafield_key.info: The configured metafield facet key (default: material).

recs_track_recent.label: Remember recently viewed (this browser)
recs_track_recent.info: Stores recently viewed products in the shopper's own browser, only after analytics consent. Never sent to or stored on the server.
